import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Verify rule f on demos 5 and 6 (parallel-seed cases): bar = perpendicular segment joining the two seed lines,
# positioned so the side nearer the 3-seed is the smaller share; plus extension of the 2-seed along its line to the bar.
def f(inp):
    g=[row[:] for row in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    s3=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==3][:2]
    s2=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==2][:2]
    ch=set()
    if len(s3)==2 and len(s2)==2:
        (r3a,c3a),(r3b,c3b)=s3
        (r2a,c2a),(r2b,c2b)=s2
        # orientation
        horiz = abs(c3b-c3a)==1 and r3a==r3b
        vert  = abs(r3b-r3a)==1 and c3a==c3b
        if horiz:
            # bar is vertical, column between the two rows' column-ranges? seeds horizontal -> bar vertical somewhere between columns
            # determine bar column: between seed3's far edge and seed2's near edge, split biased toward seed3 (smaller side on 3-side)
            lo,hi=min(c3a,c3b),max(c2a,c2b)
            # exclusive cells between: cols strictly between lo and hi... bar column must be >= lo+1? demo5: seed3 cols2-3, seed2 cols12-13, bar col7 = lo+1+? exclusive left=cols4-6 (3), right=cols8-11 (4): bar=lo+3 = hi-4. split 3|4 -> bar=lo+3 (floor((hi-lo-1)/2)+1? (hi-lo-1)=8, /2=4, +1=5? no)
            # formula: exclusive n = hi-lo-1; small_side=floor(n/2); bar=lo+small_side+1
            n=hi-lo-1
            bar=lo+ (n//2 if False else (n+1)//2) +1 if False else lo+(n+1)//2+1
            bar=lo+(n+1)//2+1  # smaller share on 3-side: left share = (n+1)//2
            # extension of seed2 along its row toward bar column
            step=1 if c2a<c2b else -1
            for c in range(min(c2a,c2b)+step, max(c2a,c2b), step):
                pass
            ext=[c for c in range(c2a,c2b+step,step)]
            e2=max(ext) if step>0 else min(ext)
            for c in range(e2+step, bar+step, step): ch.add((r2a,c))
            for r in range(min(r3a,r2a), max(r3a,r2a)+1): ch.add((r,bar))
            for c in range(bar+1, lo+1, -1): ch.add((r3a,c))
        else:
            lo,hi=min(r3a,r3b),max(r2a,r2b)
            n=hi-lo-1
            bar=lo+(n+1)//2+1
            step=1 if r2a<r2b else -1
            e2=max(ext) if False else None
            e2=max([r for r in range(r2a,r2b+step,step)]) if step>0 else min([r for r in range(r2a,r2b+step,step)])
            for r in range(e2+step, bar+step, step): ch.add((r,c2a))
            for c in range(lo,hi+1): pass
            for c in range(min(c3a,c3b),max(c3a,c3b)+1): ch.add((bar,c))
            for r in range(bar+1, lo, -1): ch.add((r,min(c3a,c3b)))
    for r,c in ch: g[r][c]=3
    return g
for k in ['Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

# Rule hypothesis: S/Z-shaped connecting path, three straight segments:
# along seed3's line, then perpendicular, then along seed2's line. Middle segment position chosen s.t. all cells bg except where seeds are, minimizing total length? Or unique feasible.
# General algorithm: try all middle-segment placements, keep those where every non-seed cell in the path is background, pick min length. Verify on all demos.

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    p3=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==3]
    p2=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==2]
    bgv=collections.Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def clear(cells): return all(g[i][j]==bgv for i,j in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # identify orientation
    o3 = len({c for _,c in p3})==1
    o2 = len({c for _,c in p2})==1
    res=None
    if o3 and o2:  # both vertical: middle horizontal
        r3=min(i for i,_ in p3); r2=min(i for i,_ in p2)
        # middle horizontal row r between? try all rows, middle cols from c2 to c3
        c3=p3[0][1]; c2=p2[0][1]
        best=None
        for r in range(min(r3,r2),max(r3,r2)+1):
            for cc in range(min(c2,c3),max(c2,c3)+1):
                cells=set()
                # from seed3 to (r,c3), then along row r to (r,c2), then to seed2
                cells.update((i,c3) for i in range(min(r3,r),max(r3,r)+1))
                cells.update((r,j) for j in range(min(cc,c2),max(cc,c2)+1))
                cells.update((i,c2) for i in range(min(r2,r),max(r2,r)+1))
                # remove seed cells themselves (they're seeds, fine)
                ns=cells-{(i,j) for i,j in p3}-(p2)
                if clear(ns):
                    L=len(cells)-len(p3)-len(p2)
                    if res is None or L<res[0]:
                        res=(L,[(i,j) for i,j in cells-p3-p2])
    else:  # both horizontal: middle vertical
        c3=p3[0][1]; c2=p2[0][1]
        r3=p3[0][0]; r2=p2[0][0]
        best=None
        for c in range(min(c2,c3),max(c2,c3)+1):
            for rr in range(min(r2,r3),max(r2,r3)+1):
                cells=set()
                cells.update((r3,j) for j in range(min(c3,c),max(c3,c)+1))
                cells.update((i,c) for i in range(min(rr,r3),max(rr,r3)+1))
                cells.update((r2,j) for j in range(min(c2,c),max(c2,c)+1))
                ns=cells-{(i,j) for i,j in p3}-set(p2)
                if clear(ns):
                    L=len(cells)-len(p3)-len(p2)
                    if res is None or L<res[0]:
                        res=(L,[(i,j) for i,j in cells-p3-p2])
    for i,j in (res[1] if res else []):
        out[i][j]=3
    return out
